def create_ones(count):
    return (10 ** count - 1) // 9

def recursive_count(n, length):
    ones = create_ones(length)
    sum_ = (n // ones) * length
    n %= ones
    if n == 0:
        return sum_
    optionA = (length + 1) + recursive_count(ones - n, length - 1)
    optionB = recursive_count(n, length - 1)
    return sum_ + min(optionA, optionB)

def main():
    input_number = int(input())
    digit_count = int((abs(input_number).bit_length() + 3) // 3.321928094887362)  # approximate log10
    print(recursive_count(input_number, digit_count))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
